events.text: The night feels unstoppable. You can keep it sweet and responsible, or you can ignore the risks because the moment is perfect.

choices.label: Keep it romantic and safe
choices.resultText: You protect the bond and your partner appreciates how thoughtful you are.

choices.label: Get carried away and hope for luck
choices.resultText: After the fun, reality hits. Something is off, and you fear the consequences.

choices.label: Talk about boundaries before the moment
choices.resultText: The trust deepens because you treat intimacy like respect.

events.text: Over breakfast, your spouse says something brave: maybe it is time to grow the family.

choices.label: Start trying for a baby
choices.resultText: You commit fully to the plan. Even if it takes time, the hope feels real.

choices.label: Wait a bit and save for stability
choices.resultText: You agree on timelines and responsibilities. Peace settles back into the home.

choices.label: If it happens, it happens
choices.resultText: You keep things calm and flexible. The relationship feels lighter.

events.text: A small comment lands wrong. Suddenly you are both defensive, and the night turns heavy.

choices.label: Apologize and ask what they meant
choices.resultText: You fix the moment before it becomes a habit.

choices.label: Assume the worst and shut them down
choices.resultText: The silence becomes a weapon. The relationship stings for months.

choices.label: Step away and cool down
choices.resultText: You prevent a fight, but you do not solve anything yet.

events.text: Someone shows interest that feels exciting. The problem is you are not single, and your choices will echo.

choices.label: Resist and focus on your marriage
choices.resultText: You choose stability over temptation. Your spouse notices the restraint.

choices.label: Give in to the temptation
choices.resultText: It feels good for a moment, then guilt hits. The damage is immediate.

choices.label: Flirt back just to feel powerful
choices.resultText: You do not cross the biggest line, but you still break trust.

events.text: Your spouse wants connection, not gifts. You have a choice: spend money, spend time, or spend both the wrong way.

choices.label: Cook together at home
choices.resultText: It is simple, but it is real. Your bond grows stronger.

choices.label: Go out and splurge
choices.resultText: The evening is perfect. The bill is not. Still, the memories matter.

choices.label: Ignore it and stay busy
choices.resultText: You meant to do it later, but later never arrives.
